seoTitle: Dump stations and LPG in Spain: what to know before the winter
seoText1: Spain is where many European motorhomes spend the winter, from the Costa Blanca to Andalusia, and the coast is busy from November to March. The questions on the road are practical ones: where can I empty the tanks, where is fresh water, and which fuel station has LPG for the heating and the cooker.
seoText2: Many Spanish towns run an área de autocaravanas with a dump station, some free and some paid, and the rules on overnight parking differ from one town to the next, so check the local signs. Before you drive to a place, make sure it is still there: the map shows what has been recorded, and things change.
otherIntro: The same counts for Portugal, and the services map for everywhere else you drive.
